project.name: GJS Java Lib Artifact archetype
project.description:
-------------------------------------------------------- Project gjs-java-lib-archetype --------------------------------------------------------
Archetype to generate the basic structure of a simple artifact project in language java. Example of use: This command generates the test-project project:
mvn -B archetype:generate \ -DarchetypeGroupId=org.gjsoft.maven.archetypes \ -DarchetypeArtifactId=gjs-java-lib-archetype \ -DarchetypeVersion=1.0.0-RC.2 \ -DshortName=test-project \ -DgroupId=org.gjsoft.test
==================================================================================== Archetype Parameters:
* shortName: Name of the project. Always lowercase. Allows two words separated by a hyphen.
* groupId: The group of the project artifact.
* artifactId: The name of the project artifact. Default is java-module. Not required.
* package: The project packaging of the source code. Default is org.gjs.maven.archetypes. Not required.
* version: The project version. Default is 1.0.0-SNAPSHOT. Not required.
====================================================================================
